title: Temporary field credential
body: Access: plot checks until the west road closes. Renewal depends on a county notice. Reverse: “Please put the old mare under cover before rain.”
rival_reading: Officials could issue field credentials with road-based expiry during an emergency; a plot assignment and an ordinary animal-care reminder do not establish a program malfunction.
gloss: A field worker’s access depends on a road closure and carries a private reminder about an animal.

title: The row with two edges
body: The map mark runs from a field row to the road. The shovel’s blade is clean except for soil inside its socket; a thumbprint crosses a pencilled plant shape.
rival_reading: A response crew could survey a farm after access changed and return its tool; soil and a marked row do not show that an agricultural program malfunctioned.
gloss: A farm map and a soil-marked tool leave the purpose of a field visit uncertain.
